items.information: Franconia Winter 2024 is a series competition to Franconia First Timers 2024, which will be held on Saturday morning. items.information: Get ready for a day of big cubes and blindfolded solving in San Jose! ## This competition does NOT have 3x3x3 Cube. ## Registrants will be accepted in the order that they pay, not the order that they register. Please be patient with us as we manually accept all eligible competitors. All attendees are required to be quiet during blindfolded events, as these events require lots of concentration. If you would like to talk during a blindfolded event, please step outside of the venue first. The registration fee for this competition is $32; however, if you have registered and paid the full fee for [BASC 56 - Bay Area Side Events Day 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BASC56BASED2024), you can register for this competition for a discounted fee of $20. **IMPORTANT: For technical reasons, you will have to pay the $32 fee in full, even if you are eligible for the discounted fee.** Once you have paid the full fee for both competitions, we will issue a $12 refund to bring your total payment down to $20. Competition Day Timing: * The competition will begin at the scheduled start time. * Lunch will end at the scheduled time. * Events will begin as soon as the previous event is wrapping up. Exception: All First Round events will not start more than 20 minutes early. * Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. In general, last call is a few minutes after the last group is called.

items.information: [CubingZA](https://www.cubingza.org/about) is excited to announce the first Cape Town competition for 2024. Dust off your cubes and get ready to set some PB's - or even records! Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, **and** make payment by buying a ticket. Please see **Registration Requirements** below. ### SPECTATORS Competitors are welcome to bring 2-3 spectators with them. Please let us know if you need to accommodate more spectators. ### VOLUNTEERING Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). ### SPONSORSHIP ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbU10IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--03db2d12875f7b21e073b29649b48a5bc813b0e2/image.png) A big thanks to [Speedcubes](https://www.speedcubes.co.za/) who are sponsoring vouchers as a part of the prizes for this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to try out and buy the different speedcubes they have on offer. ### LUCKY DRAW During prize-giving after 3x3 Finals on Sunday, we will be having a Lucky Draw for two winners to receive R250 Speedcubes.co.za vouchers each with free shipping on their order! If you needed another reason to stick around and watch 3x3 Finals other than the amazing speed of some of Africa's top speedcubers, maybe you could be one of the lucky winners and walk away with some free cubes or apparel courtesy of our local speedcubing store. #### About CubingZA CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country. In 2024, we are anticipating being able to host one competition every season in each of the cities of Cape Town, Johannesburg, and Durban, as well as other regular events in Pretoria, Bloemfontein, Limpopo, and more! If you'd be interested in helping out in CubingZA's mission to bring competitive speedcubing to the country, please [get in touch](https://cubingza.org/contact).

items.information: (BR) **Bem-vindos à segunda competição oficial de Morro Reuter!** Enquanto a maioria das pessoas viaja às praias no verão, a ideia de trazer a população cubista para um lugar calmo e tranquilo na Serra Gaúcha deu origem ao Morro Reuter em Colônia 2024! A oferta dessa competição é para aproveitar o período de férias longe do stress e tumulto das praias e grandes centros urbanos, trazendo desafios em Gincana interativa, com atividades que desenvolvam o trabalho em equipes e a melhor interação entre os competidores, especialmente crianças do Sul do Brasil. Nos vemos lá! (EN) **Welcome to the second official competition in Morro Reuter!** While most people travel to the beach during the summer, the idea of bringing the speedcubing community to a quiet and peaceful place in tthe Gaucho highlands gave birth to *Morro Reuter em Colônia 2024*! The proposition of this competition is to take advantage of the holiday season, far from the stress and chaos of the beaches and great urban centres, bringing challenges in an interactive contest, with activities that develop teamwork and the best interaction among the competitors, especially the children from Southern Brazil. See you there!

items.name: Desafío Maipú NxN 2024
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbGRmIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--4ce819179ad510ec318e2923166dc018caa0ee86/A%C3%B1adir%20un%20subt%C3%ADtulo.png) **Español** El Desafío Maipú NxN 2024 es un emocionante torneo de cubos Rubik que promete ser un evento de vanguardia en el mundo de los rompecabezas tridimensionales. En esta competición, entusiastas del cubo se reunirán para poner a prueba sus habilidades resolviendo cubos NxN, desde los clásicos 3x3 hasta los desafiantes cubos NxN de dimensiones superiores. Este torneo representa la oportunidad perfecta para demostrar destreza, estrategia y rapidez en la resolución de estos enigmáticos acertijos. Con una combinación de competencia feroz y comunidad apasionada, el Desafío Maipú NxN 2024 sin duda será un evento imperdible en el calendario de los amantes del cubo Rubik. **English** The Maipú NxN Challenge 2024 is an exciting Rubik's Cube tournament that promises to be a cutting-edge event in the world of three-dimensional puzzles. In this competition, cube enthusiasts will gather to test their skills by solving NxN cubes, ranging from the classic 3x3 to the challenging higher-dimensional NxN cubes. This tournament represents the perfect opportunity to showcase dexterity, strategy, and speed in solving these enigmatic puzzles. With a combination of fierce competition and a passionate community, the Maipú NxN Challenge 2024 will undoubtedly be a must-attend event on the Rubik's Cube lovers' calendar.

items.name: Barely Awake Boulder 2024
items.information: We are excited to welcome competitors back to Boulder for the first time since 2016, and for the second ever 24+ hour competition held in North America! Please make sure to read all tabs before registering. These tabs include important information regarding your responsibilities as a competitor and are very important! This competition has a 150 competitor limit. Please try to limit your guests that you bring to the competition! Competitions fill quickly, so it is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot. Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, this video will provide you with most of the information you need. https://youtu.be/dPL3eV-A0ww If this is your first competition, please be present 15 minutes before the competitor tutorial at 11:00 AM, which means you should plan to arrive at 10:45 AM. If you are unable to make the competition, please withdraw your registration as soon as possible by emailing the organizing team, to ensure competitors on the waitlist can compete. You will receive a 50 percent refund if you drop before the withdrawal deadline of (2024-01-20 00:00 UTC)

items.name: Cubestuff Challenge Q1 2024
items.information: ## SPECTATORS Competitors are welcome to bring up to **two** spectators with them. ## VOLUNTEERING Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). ## SPONSORSHIP A big thanks to [Cubestuff](https://cubestuff.co.za/) who are sponsoring the prizes for this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to buy the different speedcubes they have on offer. ## VENUE HEAT This is an indoor venue with fans, but no aircon. It might get quite warm if we have a hot weekend. Please be aware of this, bring enough water, and make any preparations needed. #### About CubingZA Competitions in South Africa have exploded since the end of COVID, and interest is only getting stronger. CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country.

items.information: Welcome back for a second reindition of DeNxNver! This is a winter competition put on by Colorado Cubers. All competitors should read the Competitor Responsibilities tab before registering **How to Change/Cancel Your Registration** Competitors can modify their registration through the Register tab. Competitors can also change or cancel by emailing the organization team with the following information: 1. Intent to change/cancel registration 2. Desired changes to registration 3. Name (and WCA ID, if applicable) of the competitor. In the event that a competitor cancels their registration, they will only receive a 75% refund. The deadline to change/cancel your registration is January 12th, 2023, 5:00 PM Mountain Time. **Waitlist Procedure** If registration fills up, we will place competitors on a waitlist. In the event a competitor drops from the competition, competitors will be accepted from the waitlist in the order we receive payment. Competitors can be accepted from the waitlist until January 12th at 5:00 PM MST. You will receive a full refund if you are still on the waitlist by then.

Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. Registration is open to any person, from any country. For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

items.name: Zvornik Open 2023
items.information: This is the 10th WCA competition in Bosnia and Herzegovina. The competition is open to all persons from all countries. **Note**: there is a maximum limit of ten competitors in the 3x3x3 multiblind event, on a first-come, first-served basis. If you register for multiblind after the ten slots have been filled you will be placed on a waiting list in case anybody deletes their registration later. There will be certificates and medals for all competitors in top 3 of an event. ================ Ovo je 10. WCA takmičenje u Bosni i Hercegovini. Takmičenje je otvoreno za sve osobe iz svih zemalja. **Napomena**: može biti maksimalno deset takmičara u 3x3x3 multiblind disciplini, po principu „prvi dođe, prvi uslužen“. Ako se registruje za multiblind nakon što je deset mjesta popunjeno, bit ćete stavljeni na listu čekanja, i vraćeni sa iste u slučaju da neko kasnije izbriše svoju registraciju. Za sve takmičare u prva 3 mjesta biće dodeljeni sertifikati i medalje.

items.information: [CubingZA](https://www.cubingza.org/about) is excited to announce the final Cape Town competition for 2023. This competition will have a **strong focus on 3x3**, with four rounds! 2x2 also makes a return with two rounds, and we are holding a handful of other events that have not featured in Cape Town for some time, namely 5x5, 6x6, 7x7, Megaminx, 3x3 Blindfolded, and 3x3 Multiple Blindfolded! ### SPECTATORS Competitors are welcome to bring up to **two** spectators with them. ### VOLUNTEERING Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). ### SPONSORSHIP ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbU10IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--03db2d12875f7b21e073b29649b48a5bc813b0e2/image.png) A big thanks to [Speedcubes](https://www.speedcubes.co.za/) who are sponsoring vouchers as a part of the prizes for this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to try out and buy the different speedcubes they have on offer. ### LUCKY DRAW During prize-giving after 3x3 Finals on Sunday, we will be having a Lucky Draw for two winners to receive R250 Speedcubes.co.za vouchers each with free shipping on their order! If you needed another reason to stick around and watch 3x3 Finals other than the amazing speed of some of Africa's top speedcubers, maybe you could be one of the lucky winners and walk away with some free cubes or apparel courtesy of our local speedcubing store. #### About CubingZA Competitions in South Africa have exploded since the end of COVID, and interest is only getting stronger. CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country. If you'd be interested in helping out, please [get in touch](https://cubingza.org/contact). We are particularly looking for help with communications, and graphic design.

items.information: New Zealand Nationals 2023 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations. In addition, New Zealand Nationals 2023 will crown the National Champions in 16 WCA official events, over the course of 3 days.

venue.name: “Manos Loizos” Cultural Centre of Municipality of Nikaia-Renti

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdkpWIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--d21635fc0f5cbe802272c9c1169d1a241d81b7bf/394771855_661572126079922_8082539372510634594_n.jpg) Έφτασε επιτέλους η στιγμή που περίμενε τόσα χρόνια όλη η Ελληνική Speedcubing Κοινότητα! Το 2023 βάλαμε στόχο και πετύχαμε να απογειώσουμε το Cubing στην Ελλάδα! Και τώρα να ‘μαστε, μετά από τη σειρά των τεσσάρων "Road to Nationals" Opens μέσα στο 2023 σε τέσσερα διαφορετικά σημεία της χώρας, σε κλίμα γιορτινό και με όλες τις τιμές που πρέπει, να διοργανώνουμε τα πρώτα GREEK NATIONALS στο Speedcubing! Mε μεγάλη χαρά σας καλούμε, μικρούς και μεγάλους, Cubers και Θεατές στη γιορτή του Cubing, τη δική μας γιορτή, για να περάσουμε τρεις υπέροχες μέρες! Παρακαλούμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες σχετικά με το εθνικό πρωτάθλημα του 2023. Σημαντική Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στη σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στη WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών Stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. Δείτε αυτά τα βίντεο για να είστε ετοιμασμένοι: [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg) [Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων.](https://youtu.be/x5KaXXoh7XI) The moment the entire Greek Speedcubing Community has been waiting for so many years has finally arrived! In 2023 we set a goal and succeeded in boosting Cubing in Greece! And now, after a series of four "Road to Nationals Opens" in four different locations of the country, in a festive atmosphere and with all due honors befitting the occasion, here we stand organizing the first GREEK NATIONAL CHAMPIONSHIP in Speedcubing! It is with great pleasure that we invite you, young and old, Cubers and Spectators to the celebration of Cubing, to our celebration, to spend three beautiful days! Please read through the following tabs to find all the necessary information about the 2023 Nationals Important Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register through the WCA site **AND** pay the registration fee as described in the next tabs. items.information: **(Português) Brasileiro** É com grande alegria que anunciamos o retorno do Capivara! A partir desse ano, pretendemos trabalhar com doações para fins filantrópicos, assim, além de nos divertirmos, também ajudamos a fazer um mundo melhor. Estamos trabalhando em conjunto com o [LEO e Lions](https://www.lionsclubs.org/) para arrecadar brinquedos e alimentos para crianças carentes, então todo o lucro da competição será revertido para essa campanha. Além disso, se você quiser fazer uma doação no dia, também será muito bem-vinda. Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento correto, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações abaixo em "Requisitos para inscrição". Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer neste [vídeo](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=hfp2rKaN8jHPI_RL). É muito importante que você conheça todo o regulamento, que podem ser lido [aqui](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/). Teremos premiação para todas as modalidades oficiais e premiação extra-oficial para as modalidades 'Feminino' e 'Iniciante', que tomarão como referência a classificação geral na modalidade '3x3x3'. **English** It is in great excitement that we announce the return of Capivara! From this year on, we intend to work with donations for philanthropic purposes, therefore, in addition to having fun, we can also help make a better world. We are working together with [LEO and Lions](https://www.lionsclubs.org/) to collect toys and food to children in need, so all profit from the competition will be directed to that campaign. Besides that, if you would like to give a donation on the spot, it will also be very welcome. Your registration will only be approved in the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information below in "Registration requirements". If you have any problem on how to register, take a look at this [video](https://youtu.be/dZQiw5v8Bm0?si=6Yf5Zun_nlTfECTy). It is very important that you know the regulations, which may be read [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). We will have awards for all official events, and also unofficial awards to the events 'Female' and 'Beginner', which will consider the final ranking in the '3x3x3' event.

items.information: NZ North Island Championship 2023 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations. In addition, NZ North Island Championship 2023 is the last regional championship of 2023 in the lead up to Nationals in December.

items.name: Rubik's UK Championship 2023
items.information: ## Welcome to Rubik's UK Championship 2023! ### This year's UK National Championship! #### Please read ALL tabs before registering as there is lots of information which will be new to you, even if you are an experienced competitor. ##### Spectators are welcome! Please read the information below, and the information in the [Guests, Spectators, and Media](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksUKChampionship2023#32058-guests-spectators-and-media) tab. **Free T-Shirt:** By registering and attending Rubik's UK Championship 2023, you'll receive a Rubik's UK Championship 2023 t-shirt as a memento! **Please fill in your registration comment with your t-shirt size.** **Guests:** Guests will **only** be permitted to attend by paying a **£5** fee **at the competition**. Competitors will receive lanyards, and their guests and spectators will receive wristbands, which are to be worn throughout the weekend for security reasons. **This includes parents/guardians of competitors.** The fee must be paid at the competition and cannot be prepaid beforehand. The guest field in the registration form is for informational purposes only; the fee must be paid at the competition. We accept cash or card payments. **Qualification Requirements:** If you do not meet the qualification requirements outlined in the [Events tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksUKChampionship2023#competition-events) in an official WCA competition by *9th October 2023*, you will not be eligible to compete in those events. You will not be able to add events to your registration which you do not qualify for, but can update your registration if you later qualify for them. There are no qualifications in 3x3, 2x2, Pyraminx, or Skewb, so **newcomers will be able to compete in these events only**. **Final Round Advancements:** For all events with more than one round, we will be taking a minimum number of UK competitors to the final. If necessary, we will increase the size of the final by one competitor at a time until we have enough UK competitors. The requirements are as follows: 2x2, 4x4, 5x5, 6x6, 7x7, 3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3 One-Handed, Clock, Megaminx, Pyraminx, Skewb, Square-1 - 6 UK competitors; 3x3 - 8 UK competitors. 3x3 Multiple Blindfolded has a Top 16 qualification requirement, similarly this must contain at least 6 UK competitors. **Fewest Moves:** FMC will **not** be held at this competition. To compete for the national champion title for FMC, you must compete at [Rubik's UK Championship FMC 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksUKChampionshipFMC2023). The winner of the FMC competition will be awarded their prize during the awards at Rubik's UK Championship 2023. **Please Note:** As this is the UK National Championship, only competitors who represent the United Kingdom will be eligible for prizes. The competition remains open for all nationalities to compete. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBa0pMIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--bcff7b5bdf0f0846e919c48b2fc43d8a54c9d36f/UKC%202023%20LOGO%20-%20RGB%20(FOR%20SCREENS)%20-%20(TRANSPARENT)%20-%20(WITH%20SPONSORSHIP).png)

items.information: Estamos muy emocionados de anunciar esta competencia tan explosiva, Volcano in Puebla 2023. Te invitamos a participar y competir en nuestra hermosa ciudad de Puebla, hogar de cemitas y de Don Goyo. Esta competencia es posible gracias al apoyo del **Instituto Municipal del Deporte** y el **Puebla Rubik's Team**. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la WCA. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcE5KIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--1aa6d40f717b497f565be1b12569bbfda1402653/Logo%20Volcano%20final.png) We are so happy to announce this competition, Volcano in Puebla 2023. We invite you to participate and to compete in our beautiful city of Puebla, place of cemitas and Don Goyo. This competition is possible thanks to the support of the **Instituto Municipal del Deporte** and **Puebla Rubik's Team**. This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/)

items.information: Another competition to be held at UC Berkeley! * Registrants will be accepted in the order that they pay, not the order that they register. Please be patient with us as we manually accept all eligible competitors. * Competitors may only bring one guest maximum. **Competition Day Timing** - The competition will begin at the scheduled start time. - Lunch will end at the scheduled time. - Events will begin as soon as the previous event is wrapping up. Exception: All First Round events will not start more than 20 minutes early. - Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. In general, last call is a few minutes after the last group is called.

items.name: V-Cube Spiel A 2023
items.information: V-Cubes is proud to bring back cubing competitions to Spiel Messe in Essen! **Note:** V-Cube Spiel A 2023 is a series competition to V-Cube Spiel B 2023 on the same weekend. Please note that you may only register for one of the two competitions. V-Cubes ist stolz darauf, wieder Speedcubing-Turniere auf der SPIEL Messe in Essen präsentieren zu dürfen! **Wichtig:** V-Cube Spiel A 2023 ist eine Partner-Competition von V-Cube Spiel B 2023, die am gleichen Wochenende stattfindet. Bitte beachte, dass du dich nur für eines der beiden Turniere anmelden darfst. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbDRkIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--ef25795363481ab9b918d882fa96ca2c55097150/v-cube.png) To participate in this competition, you must have a ticket for Saturday at the Essen Spiel Messe exposition. This ticket needs to be bought individually and is not included in the registration fee. The competition will take place at Hall 5, Booth 5A108. You can see the site plan of Messe Essen [here](https://www.messe-essen.de/media/neue-medien/dreiklang/anreise-parkplaetze-downloads/gelaendeplaene/messe_essen_gelaendeplan.pdf). If you are a new competitor, take a look at the corresponding tab. All competitors should be familiar with the information in the tab. Um an diesem Wettbewerb teilnehmen zu können, brauchst du ein Ticket für den Samstag der Essen Spiel Messe. Dieses Ticket muss individuell erworben werden und ist nicht im Eintrittspreis enthalten. Das Turnier findet in Halle 5 am Stand 5A108 statt. Den Geländeplan der Messe Essen findest du [hier](https://www.messe-essen.de/media/neue-medien/dreiklang/anreise-parkplaetze-downloads/gelaendeplaene/messe_essen_gelaendeplan.pdf). Wenn du ein neuer Teilnehmer bist, wirf einen Blick auf den zugehörigen Tab. Alle Teilnehmer sollten mit den Informationen vertraut sein.

A disqualified competitor is not eligible for the refund of any expenses due to participating in the competition, as per regulation [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1). * Competitors must bring their own puzzles. * Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called, otherwise the competitor will be penalized with the disqualification of the event, in accordance with regulation [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) of the WCA Regulations. * It is important to read all the information available in the competition website. Feel free to contact the organizers or the WCA Delegates.

items.information: [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) ## Ontario Favourites Fall 2023 Series This competition is in a series with [Pickering Favourites Fall 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PickeringFavouritesFall2023). You will only be able to compete in ***one*** of these two competitions. ***Attempting to register for both competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted.*** ### Registration Reminders Since this is a "favourites" competition, **you may choose at most five (5) events**. You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted and registration fees will not be transferred across competitions. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. ### Mailing List We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand for competitions in southern Ontario and are regularly planning and announcing more competitions. items.information: This competition features a 30 minute cumulative time limit for 5x5, 6x6, and 7x7 all together. This means that you have a combined total of 30 minutes to complete your 5x5, 6x6, and 7x7 solves (you can sign up for any combination of the 3). You can choose to do the events in any order, but you must finish an event's average (or DNS the rest) before moving on to the next event. Please review regulation [#A1a2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#A1a2) if you wish to compete in either 5x5, 6x6, or 7x7. There will also be a 25 minute cumulative time limit for 3x3 Blindfolded. The competition will take place in Meeting Rooms #1-3 in the RPAC.

items.information: [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) ### (EN) ### Registration Reminders Since this is a "favourites" competition, **you may choose at most four (4) events**. You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations and registrations with more than four (4) events will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. ### Mailing List We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand for competitions in southern Ontario and are regularly planning and announcing more competitions. Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ### Competitor Requirements This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors should be familiar with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, you may want to look at the [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/files/WCA_Competition_Tutorial.pdf). For new competitors, this video may help with competing. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww&t=2s Please see tabs for more information about the competition. ## Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms. ### (FR) ### Rappels concernant l'inscription Comme il s'agit là d'une compétition de type " favoris ", **vous pouvez choisir au maximum quatre (4) épreuves**. Vous devez vous inscrire *et payer les frais d'inscription* avant que votre inscription ne soit acceptée. Les inscriptions non payées et les inscriptions comportant plus de quatre (4) épreuves ne seront pas acceptées. Voir les sections **Liste des compétiteurs** et **Liste d'attente** au bas de cette page pour plus de détails. ### Liste de diffusion Nous travaillons fort pour répondre à la demande de compétitions dans le sud de l'Ontario et nous planifions et annonçons régulièrement de nouvelles compétitions. Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada] (https://speedcubingcanada.org/fr) sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou (https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) vous inscrire à notre liste de diffusion pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions. ### Exigences pour les compétiteurs Cette compétition est reconnue comme une compétition officielle de la World Cube Association. Par conséquent, tous les concurrents doivent être familiers avec les [règlements de la WCA] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Si vous n'avez jamais participé à une compétition, vous pouvez consulter le [Tutoriel de la compétition de la WCA] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/files/WCA_Competition_Tutorial.pdf). Pour les nouveaux concurrents, cette vidéo peut les aider à participer à la compétition. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww&t=2s Veuillez consulter les onglets pour plus d'informations sur la compétition. ### Avis de droit à l'image Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.

items.name: Gotland Open 2023
items.information: Välkomna till Gotland Open 2023, den första WCA-tävlingen på Gotland! Tävlingen hålls på Gangvide Farm på Gotlands östkust ca 1 mil söder om Ljugarn. Gangvide farm är ett mysigt ställe där man kan äta färska ägg till frukost och ta ett dopp i ån! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter. Det blir en 2,5-dagarstävling med alla 17 WCA-grenar. Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information, speciellt fliken "resa". *Om du inte tävlar i 4x4 BLD / 5x5 BLD behöver du inte närvara under lördagen* ----- Welcome to Gotland Open 2023, the first WCA competition on the island of Gotland! The competition is held at Gangvide Farm on the east coast of Gotland about 10 km south of Ljugarn. Gangvide Farm is a cozy place where you can eat fresh eggs for breakfast and even take a swim in the river! Everyone is welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes. It's a 2,5 day competition with all 17 WCA events. Please read all the information tabs because they contain valuable information, especially the travel tab. *If you are not competing in 4x4 BLD / 5x5 BLD you do not need to be present during Saturday.*

items.name: 24 Hours in Flen 2023
items.information: Varmt välkomna till denna 24-timmarstävling i Flen! Precis som vanligt så är alla som önskar varmt välkomna att delta, men vi vill ändå utfärda en kraftig varning kring att tävlingen pågår nonstop i just 24 timmar, och har ett väldigt speciellt koncept. Därför passar tävlingen sannolikt inte varken nya eller yngre deltagare särskilt bra. Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida så du inte missar någon viktig information, särskilt fliken **koncept**. Notera också att en sängplats (vandrarhemsstandard) över natten samt frukost ingår i anmälningsavgiften, i samma hus som tävlingen genomförs i. -- A warm welcome to this 24-hour competition in Flen! Just as usual, everyone who wishes is warmly welcome to participate, but we still want to issue a strong warning that the competition runs non-stop for exactly 24 hours, and has a very special concept. Therefore, the competition probably does not suit neither new or younger participants very well. Please read through all the tabs on this page so you don't miss any important information, especially the **concept** tab. Also note that a hostel style bed and breakfast is included in the registration fee, in the same house as the competition will take place in.

items.information: NZ South Island Championship 2023 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations. In addition, NZ South Island Championship 2023 is the first regional championship of 2023 in the lead up to Nationals later in 2023.

items.name: Pickering Side Events 2023
items.information: [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) ## Pickering Side Events 2023 Cubing on the Canada Day long weekend! As we celebrate our country and communities, Canada Day is also an important opportunity to reflect on the historical and ongoing colonization and erasure of Indigenous Peoples on the lands we now call Canada. This competition will be held on the Treaty and traditional territory of the Mississaugas of Scugog Island First Nation and Williams Treaties signatories of the Mississauga and Chippewa Nations. All proceeds from this competition will be donated to the [Indian Residential School Survivors Society](https://www.irsss.ca) and [Woodland Cultural Centre](https://woodlandculturalcentre.ca). ## Side Events This competition has "side events", which does _not_ include the standard 3x3x3 Cube event. Please consider registering for [another competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada&show_registration_status=on) if this competition is not suitable for you. ## Registration Reminders You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. ## Mailing List We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand for competitions in southern Ontario and are regularly planning and announcing more competitions. Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ## Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.information: ##### *English version is below* #### **Deutsch:** Wir freuen uns sehr euch Vienna Big Cube Summer 2023 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können. Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von David Burany, Florian Truckenthanner, Felix Strasser, Lucas Höglinger, Jeremia Neuhold und delegiert von Bence Barát und Viktor Kalmar. Erneut findet das Turnier im großen Saal der Akkonplatz Pfarre statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt. Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen! Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen. Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich! ----- #### **English:** We are happy to announce the Vienna Big Cube Summer 2023 as an official WCA Competition. The speedcubing competition is organised by David Burany, Florian Truckenthanner, Felix Strasser, Lucas Höglinger, Jeremia Neuhold and delegated by Bence Barát and Viktor Kalmar. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations. Every Competitor can bring one guest.

items.name: Stockholmsligan Final 2023
items.information: Varmt välkomna till finaltävlingen i vårsäsongen av Stockholmsligan 2023! Mer information om Stockholmligans upplägg finns under fliken med samma namn. Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida så du inte missar någon viktig information. Tävlingen har ett väldigt speciellt upplägg, där varje deltagare har totalt 18 minuter i lösningstid på sig att genomföra alla sina lösningar, och deltagaren får själv välja vilka grenar man vill spendera sin tid på. Notera dock att varje deltagare denna gång **får välja maximalt fem (5) grenar** att tävla i. **OBS:** Anmäler du dig till antingen 3x3x3 FMC eller 3x3x3 Multi-Blind så kan du endast tävla i just den grenen och inte tävla i någon annan gren på tävlingen. -- A warm welcome to final competition in the spring season of Stockholmsligan 2023! More information about the league's structure can be found under the tab with the same name. Please read through all the tabs on this page so you don't miss any important information. The competition has a very special format, where each competitor has a total of 18 minutes of solving time to complete all their solves, and the competitor gets to choose which events to spend their time on. Note, however, that each competitor this time **can choose a maximum of five (5) events** to compete in. **N.B.:** If you register for either 3x3x3 FMC or 3x3x3 Multi-Blind, you can only compete in that particular event and not compete in any other event at the competition.

items.information: CubingZA is excited to announce South Africa's 2023 National Championship. Compete against South Africa's fastest speedcubers and break some records! All WCA events except FMC* will be held, with winners in each event being declared the 2023 South African Champion for that event. # SPECTATORS Competitors are allowed to bring up to 2 guests as spectators. Spectators attend for free. # VOLUNTEERING Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at this video. Parents and spectators are welcome to help out with volunteer tasks as well. # SPONSORS Massive thanks to the following sponsors, without whom this competition would not be happening. items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz. **ATENÇÃO:** Está é uma competição que não terá o Cubo 3x3x3 como uma de suas modalidades. --- Registration is open to any person, from any country. With a view to the smooth running of the competition, by registering for a category, you also undertake to help as a judge or scrambler in that category (as provided for in the WCA rules). In this way, the competition becomes self-sustaining, and the activities are divided among all participants, not becoming heavy for just a few. At least two groups were made in each modality. In one of the groups you compete and in the other you help to scramble or judge. **ATTENTION:** This competition will not have the 3x3x3 Cube as one of its events.

The Swedish Champion in this event will be crowned at the separate competition [Swedish FMC Championship 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SwedishFMCChampionship2023). items.information: Please read through the [regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition. We highly recommend not bringing any guests. However, we're required to allow 1 guest per competitor. Competitors will be divided into two groups. **Attending the entire competition and judging/scrambling for the group you aren't competing in is mandatory.** You may register to however many events you want, but keep in mind that the combined time limit for finishing your solves is 25 minutes. (e.g. after five 2x2 solves of 10 seconds you have 24:10 left for the remaining events) You may choose the order of the events you compete in. However, you must finish one event before starting a new one. Lue säännöt ([englanniksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/), [suomeksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/finnish/)) ennen kilpailua. Suosittelemme saapumaan ilman vieraita. Joudumme kuitenkin sallimaan yhden vieraan per kilpailija. Kilpailijat jaetaan kahteen ryhmään. **Paikallaolo koko kilpailun ajan on pakollista ja sinun täytyy tuomaroida/sekoittaa ryhmässä jossa et kilpaile.** Voit ilmoittautua kuinka moneen lajiin tahansa, mutta pidä mielessä, että kokonaisaikaraja kaikille ratkaisuille on 25 minuuttia. (esim. viiden 10 sekunnin 2x2 ratkaisun jälkeen aikaa lopuille lajeille on 24:10) Voit valita järjestyksen lajeille, joissa kilpailet. Edellinen laji pitää kuitenkin lopettaa ennen seuraavan aloittamista.

items.information: Hjertelig velkommen til vår andre hverdagskubing på LSP i Oslo. Kveldens konkurranse har et veldig spesielt opplegg, der hver deltaker har 18 minutter i total løsningstid til å gjennomføre alle sine løsninger. Det er deltageren selv som på forhånd velger hvilke grener man vil delta i og bruke sine 18 minutter på. Konkurransen foregår mandag kveld og varer i tilsammen ca 4 timer og du kan delta i maks 5 grener. Vi holder til i et lite lokale sentralt i Oslo der LSPkuberne pleier å ha kubetreff. Vi håper at både erfarne og nye speedcubere i Oslo har lyst til å prøve seg på konkurranser lokalt. Vi vil lage månedlige konkurranser framover og se hvilket format som funker. Målet er å starte Osloligaen til høsten, der vi kårer en vinner etter resultatene fra flere små konkurranser gjennom høsten og vinteren. Lokalet er har minimalt med tilskuerplass, så det er fint hvis antall gjester er så lavt som mulig. Konkurransen er sponset av NORDICUBE og SLOAP. -------------------- Welcome to the second edition of LSP Hverdagskubing in Oslo. This competitions has a very special format, where each competitor has a total of 18 minutes of solving time to complete all their solves. The competitor gets to choose which events to spend their time on. Note, that each competitor can choose a maximum of five (5) events to compete in. The competition, which this time takes place on a Monday, lasts only approx. 4 hours. Please read through all the tabs on this page (especially "Hverdagskubing") so you don't miss any important information. We are based in a small venue in the center of Oslo where the LSPcubers tend to have cube meetings. We hope that both experienced and new speedcubers in Oslo want to join these local competitions. We will create monthly competitions in the future and see which format works. The aim is to start the Oslo League in the autumn, where we will choose a winner based on the results of several small competitions throughout the autumn and winter. The venue has limited space for guests. Please bring as few guests as possible. The competition is sponsored by NORDICUBE and SLOAP.

items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. --- Registration is open to any person, from any country. For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

items.information: [CubingZA](https://www.cubingza.org/about) is excited to announce the second Cape Town competition for 2023. This competition will take on a "Big & Weird" theme on Saturday, with bigger NxN cubes and some side events not often held in Cape Town, with a more familiar event structure on Sunday! Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, **and** make payment by buying a ticket on our [Quicket](https://www.quicket.co.za/events/208588-cubingza-cape-cubes-autumn-2023/#/) page. ### SPECTATORS Competitors are welcome to bring up to **two** spectators with them. ### VOLUNTEERING Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). ### SPONSORSHIP ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbU10IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--03db2d12875f7b21e073b29649b48a5bc813b0e2/image.png) A big thanks to [Speedcubes](https://www.speedcubes.co.za/) who are sponsoring vouchers as a part of the prizes for this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to try out and buy the different speedcubes they have on offer. ### LUCKY DRAW During prize-giving after 3x3 Finals on Sunday, we will be having a Lucky Draw for two winners to receive R250 Speedcubes.co.za vouchers each with free shipping on their order! If you needed another reason to stick around and watch 3x3 Finals other than the amazing speed of some of Africa's top speedcubers, maybe you could be one of the lucky winners and walk away with some free cubes or apparel courtesy of our local speedcubing store. #### About CubingZA Competitions in South Africa have exploded since the end of COVID, and interest is only getting stronger. CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country. If you'd be interested in helping out, please [get in touch](https://cubingza.org/contact). We are particularly looking for help with communications, and graphic design.

items.information: Please read through the [regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition. We highly recommend not bringing any guests. However, we're required to allow 1 guest per competitor. Competitors will be divided into two groups. **Attending the entire competition and judging/scrambling for the group you aren't competing in is mandatory.** You may register to however many events you want, but keep in mind that the combined time limit for finishing your solves is 22 minutes. (e.g. after five 2x2 solves of 10 seconds you have 21:10 left for the remaining events) You may choose the order of the events you compete in. However, you must finish one event before starting a new one. Lue säännöt ([englanniksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/), [suomeksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/finnish/)) ennen kilpailua. Suosittelemme saapumaan ilman vieraita. Joudumme kuitenkin sallimaan yhden vieraan per kilpailija. Kilpailijat jaetaan kahteen ryhmään. **Paikallaolo koko kilpailun ajan on pakollista ja sinun täytyy tuomaroida/sekoittaa ryhmässä jossa et kilpaile.** Voit ilmoittautua kuinka moneen lajiin tahansa, mutta pidä mielessä, että kokonaisaikaraja kaikille ratkaisuille on 22 minuuttia. (esim. viiden 10 sekunnin 2x2 ratkaisun jälkeen aikaa lopuille lajeille on 21:10) Voit valita järjestyksen lajeille, joissa kilpailet. Edellinen laji pitää kuitenkin lopettaa ennen seuraavan aloittamista.

Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](http://speedcubingcanada.org) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. items.name: Rahn Education Leipzig 2023
items.information: **Deutsch** Wir laden euch herzlich ein zur ersten Competition in **Leipzig** in der Geschichte der WCA. Nach über 12 Jahren findet endlich wieder eine Competition in Sachsen statt und wir, das Orga-Team freuen uns auf euer zahlreiches Erscheinen. Euch erwartet eine schöne Venue in perfekter zentraler Lage in Leipzig und ein motiviertes Orga-Team. Lasst uns gemeinsam dafür sorgen, dass die Competition **Rahn Education Leipzig** ein traditionelles Event in der WCA wird. **Bitte lies dir alle Tabs sorgfältig durch, damit du mit dem Ablaufplan und allen Modalitäten vertraut bist.** **English** We cordially invite you to the first competition in **Leipzig** in the history of the WCA. After more than 12 years, there is finally a competition in Saxony and we, the organizing team, are looking forward to your numerous appearances. You can expect a beautiful venue in a perfect central location in Leipzig and a motivated organizational team. Let's work together to ensure that the **Rahn Education Leipzig** competition becomes a traditional event in the WCA. **Please read all tabs carefully so you are familiar with the schedule and all modalities.**

items.name: Pickering A 2023
items.information: ## Pickering 2023 Series We are running four competitions as part of the Pickering 2023 Series. You will only be able to compete in *one* of these four competitions. Attempting to register for more than one of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted. ## Registration Reminder You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. ## Mailing List We are aware of the extremely high demand for competitions in Ontario. We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand and are regularly planning and announcing more and larger competitions. Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](http://speedcubingcanada.org) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. Thank you for your patience during this time as we work to scale up to the exciting growth of the cubing community. ## Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.name: Vardagscubing IV - Gamla Uppsala 2023
items.information: Varmt välkommen till den fjärde svenska upplagan av Vardagscubing, denna gång i Uppsala! Tävlingen har ett väldigt speciellt upplägg, där varje deltagare har totalt 21 minuter i lösningstid på sig att genomföra alla sina lösningar, och deltagaren får själv välja vilka grenar man vill spendera sin tid på. Notera dock att varje deltagare denna gång **får välja maximalt fem (5) grenar** att tävla i. Tävlingen, som denna gång går på en **tisdag** pågår endast i drygt 3 timmar. Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida (särskilt "Vardagscubing") så du inte missar någon viktig information. **OBS:** Anmäler du dig till antingen 3x3x3 FMC eller 3x3x3 Multi-Blind så kan du endast tävla i just den grenen och inte tävla i någon annan gren på tävlingen. -- Welcome to the fourth Swedish edition of Vardagscubing, this time in Uppsala! The competition has a very special format, where each competitor has a total of 21 minutes of solving time to complete all their solves, and the competitor gets to choose which events to spend their time on. Note, however, that each competitor this time **can choose a maximum of five (5) events** to compete in. The competition, which this time takes place on a **Tuesday**, lasts only roughly 3 hours. Please read through all the tabs on this page (especially "Vardagscubing") so you don't miss any important information. **N.B.:** If you register for either 3x3x3 FMC or 3x3x3 Multi-Blind, you can only compete in that particular event and not compete in any other event at the competition.

items.information: ##### *English version is below* #### **Deutsch:** Wir freuen uns sehr euch Vienna Fasching 2023 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können. Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von Viktor Kalmar, Pranjal Khan, Florian Truckenthanner, David Dinh, Jeremia Neuhold und delegiert von Bence Barát. Erneut findet das Turnier im großen Saal der Akkonplatz Pfarre statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt. Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen! Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen. Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich! ----- #### **English:** We are happy to announce the Vienna Fasching 2023 as an official WCA Competition. The speedcubing competition is organised by Viktor Kalmar, Pranjal Khan, Florian Truckenthanner, David Dinh, Jeremia Neuhold and delegated by Bence Barát. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. OHARRA: Zure lehen lehiaketa bada, aurretik ['lehiaketa arrunt'](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AmoreOpen2023) batera joatea gomendatzen dizugu. Parte hartzeko ezinbestekoa da [formulario hau](https://forms.gle/iWCecxy5zJgC5bv66) betetzea, eta bi taldeetan egon, hasieratik amaierara. Informazio gehiago LEHIAKETAREN FUNTZIONAMENDUA erlaitzean. WARNING: If you're a new competitor, we recommend you attend a ['normal' competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AmoreOpen2023) first. This competition will be a test, in which each competitor will do their averages in the order they want. To participate at this competition, it is mandatory to fill out [this form](https://forms.gle/iWCecxy5zJgC5bv66), and also attend both groups. items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ2N0IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--83fc6c836b78e431cd8e0d013efd6be412a6e388/IMG_9500.JPG) Athens Winter Open 2023 είναι ο πρώτος διαγωνισμός για φέτος στην Ελλάδα , ύστερα από μία πολλά υποσχόμενη χρονιά. Στις επόμενες διοργανώσεις, θα εστιάζουμε πάντα σε 2 διοργανώσεις που δεν είναι ακόμα πολύ γνωστές στην Ελλάδα. Σε αυτό το διαγωνισμό θέλουμε να φέρουμε τα αγωνίσματα του 6x6 και του 7x7 πιο κοντά στους συμμετέχοντες. Ο στόχος είναι να διεξαχθεί το πρώτο ελληνικό εθνικό πρωτάθλημα προς το τέλος του τρέχοντος έτους. Μέχρι τότε, όλες οι εκδηλώσεις θα είναι οικείες στους συμμετέχοντες. Πάρτε τους κύβους σας, ετοιμαστείτε, διαβάστε τους κανόνες και ελάτε σε μία ακόμα γιορτή για το cubing γιορτή του cubing! Παρακαλώ διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείτε ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registrations στο site της wca και να γίνει η πληρωμή της εισόδου, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. Athens Winter Open 2023 is the first competition this year in Greece, following a very successfull year of competitions. In the next competitions, we will always focus on 2 events that are not yet very well known in Greece. In this competition we want to bring the events 6x6 and 7x7 closer to the competitors. The goal is to make the first Greek National Championship towards the end of this year. By then, all events will be familiar to the competitors. Grab your cubes, study the regulations and attend the greek feast of cubing! Please read the following tabs very carefully! Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the eca site and pay the fee as described in the nexts tabs.

items.name: Vardagscubing III - Ålidenskolan Open B 2023
items.information: Varmt välkommen till den tredje svenska upplagan av Vardagscubing, i samarbete med Ålidenskolan i Flen! Tävlingen har ett väldigt speciellt upplägg, där varje deltagare har totalt 18 minuter i lösningstid på sig att genomföra alla sina lösningar, och deltagaren får själv välja vilka grenar man vill spendera sin tid på. Tävlingen, som hålls på en **fredag**, pågår endast i 3,5 timmar. Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida (särskilt "Vardagscubing") så du inte missar någon viktig information. **OBS:** Anmäler du dig till antingen 3x3x3 FMC eller 3x3x3 Multi-Blind så kan du endast tävla i just den grenen och inte tävla i någon annan gren på tävlingen. **OBS:** Notera att du bara får anmäla dig till (och delta på) en av de två tävlingarna som hålls i Flen denna dag. -- A warm welcome to the third Swedish edition of Vardagscubing, in collaboration with Ålidenskolan in Flen! The competition has a very special format, where each participant has a total of 18 minutes of solving time to complete all their solves, and the competitor gets to choose which events to spend their time on. The competition, which this time takes place on a **Friday**, lasts only 3,5 hours. Please read through all the tabs on this page (especially "Vardagscubing") so you don't miss any important information. **N.B.:** If you register for either 3x3x3 FMC or 3x3x3 Multi-Blind, you can only compete in that particular event and not compete in any other event at the competition. **N.B:** Note that you may only register for (and participate in) one of the two competitions held in Flen that day.

items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. **ATENÇÃO:** Está é uma competição que não terá o Cubo 3x3x3 como uma de suas modalidades, apenas modalidades conhecidas como side events, portanto, não é uma competição indicada para iniciantes. Esta competição será realizada em um formato diferente do tradicional, neste campeonato, os competidores terão uma hora de limite para fazer todos os eventos que quiserem na ordem em que desejarem. Em um grupo serão juízes, no outro, competidores e em outro, embaralhadores. --- Registration is open to any person, from any country. For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff. **ATTENTION:** This competition will not have the 3x3x3 Cube as one of it's events, only the ones known as side events, that said, it is not a competition indicated for beginners This competition will happen in a format different from the traditional, at this competition, the competitors will have an hour to do all the events they want in the order they want. In a group they will be judges, on the other, competitors and in a last one, scramblers.

items.name: Vardagscubing II - Hive A 2022
items.information: Välkommen till Vardagscubing II - Hive A 2022, som hålls i centrala Stockholm. Detta är din chans att bli av med de extra kalorierna från julmaten de närmasta dagarna innan tävlingen! Alla är varmt välkomna att tävla, men vänligen läs igenom alla flikar på denna sida för att se till att du inte missar någon viktig information om tävlingen. ### Vänligen notera: * **3x3x3 FMC kan inte kombineras med någon annan gren. 4x4x4 BLD och 5x5x5 BLD kan inte kombineras med 3x3x3 Multi-Blind (och vice versa).** * **Varje deltagare får ta med högst en gäst till denna tävling. Varje gäst måste betala en inträdesavgift på 30 SEK för att få komma in i lokalen.** Läs "extra registration requirements" för mer information. * **Lokalen ligger i en kontorsarbetsplats med hög fysisk säkerhet och du kommer inte att kunna komma och gå som du vill.** Du måste antingen anlända till ytterdörren senast fem minuter innan den första grenen ska starta, eller ge dig själv gott om tid innan din första gren för att se till att någon har tid att släppa in dig. Information om telefonnummer till utvalda Hive Streaming-anställda kommer att mailas till dig dagen innan tävlingen, i fall du behöver ringa någon för att släppa in dig på kontoret. * **Notera att du bara får anmäla dig till (och delta på) en av de två tävlingarna som hålls i Stockholm denna dag.** --- Welcome to Vardagscubing II - Hive A 2022, held in downtown Stockholm. This is your chance to work off some of those extra calories from the Christmas food of the past few days! Everyone is warmly welcome to compete, but please read through all tabs on this site to make sure you don't miss any important information about the competition. ### Please note: * **3x3x3 FMC can not be combined with any other event. 4x4x4 BLD and 5x5x5 BLD can not be combined with 3x3x3 Multi-Blind (and vice versa).** * **Every competitor can bring at most one guest to this competition. Every attending guest will have to pay an entry fee of 30 SEK to be allowed inside the venue.** Please read the extra registration requirements for more information. * **The venue is an office workplace with a high level of physical security, and you will not be able to come and go as you please.** You must either arrive at the front door no later than five minutes before the first event is scheduled to start, or give yourself ample time before your first event to make sure that someone can find the time to let you in. Details of contact phone numbers to selected Hive Streaming employees will be emailed to you the day before the competition, in case you need to call someone to let you in to the office. * **Note that you may only register for (and participate in) one of the two competitions held in Stockholm that day.**

items.information: New Zealand Nationals 2022 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations. In addition, New Zealand Nationals 2022 will crown the National Champions in 16 WCA official events, over the course of 3 days.

items.name: Vardagscubing I - Uppsala 2022
items.information: Varmt välkommen till den första svenska upplagan av Vardagscubing, denna gång i Uppsala! Tävlingen har ett väldigt speciellt upplägg, där varje deltagare har totalt 20 minuter i lösningstid på sig att genomföra alla sina lösningar, och deltagaren får själv välja vilka grenar man vill spendera sin tid på. Tävlingen, som denna gång går på en **måndag** pågår endast i 4 timmar. Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida (särskilt "Vardagscubing") så du inte missar någon viktig information. **OBS:** Anmäler du dig till antingen 3x3x3 FMC eller 3x3x3 Multi-Blind så kan du endast tävla i just den grenen och inte tävla i någon annan gren på tävlingen. -- Welcome to the first Swedish edition of Vardagscubing, this time in Uppsala! The competition has a very special format, where each participant has a total of 20 minutes of solving time to complete all their solves, and the competitor gets to choose which events to spend their time on. The competition, which this time takes place on a **Monday**, lasts only 4 hours. Please read through all the tabs on this page (especially "Vardagscubing") so you don't miss any important information. **N.B.:** If you register for either 3x3x3 FMC or 3x3x3 Multi-Blind, you can only compete in that particular event and not compete in any other event at the competition.

items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. --- Registration is open to any person, from any country. For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

items.name: Kewbz UK Championship 2022
items.information: ## Welcome to Kewbz UK Championship 2022! ### This year's UK National Championship ##### Spectators are welcome! Please read the information below, and the information in the [Spectators and Guests](#22468-spectators-and-guests) tab. If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs. **Free T-Shirt:** By registering and attending Kewbz UK Championship 2022, you'll receive a completely free UK Championship t-shirt as a memento! You will receive this on registration at the venue, where you can choose your size. **Guests:** Guests will **only** be permitted to attend by paying a **£5** fee **at the competition**. Competitors will receive lanyards, and their guests and spectators will receive wristbands, which are to be worn throughout the weekend for security reasons. **This includes parents/guardians of competitors.** The fee must be paid at the competition and cannot be prepaid beforehand. The guest field in the registration form is for informational purposes only, the fee must be paid at the competition. **Qualification Requirements:** If you do not meet the qualification requirements in an official WCA competition by *17th October 2022*, you will not be eligible to compete in those events. Please see the **Events** tab to see these requirements. Please note that **new competitors can only compete in 3x3, 2x2, Skewb and Pyraminx**. **Final Round Advancements:** For all events with more than one round we will be taking a minimum number of UK competitors to the final. If necessary, we will increase the size of the final by one competitor at a time until we have enough UK competitors. The requirements are as follows: 2x2, 4x4, 5x5, 6x6, 7x7, 3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3 One-Handed, Clock, Megaminx, Pyraminx, Skewb, Square-1 - 6 UK competitors; 3x3 - 8 UK competitors. 3x3 Multiple Blindfolded has a Top 16 qualification requirement, similarly this must contain at least 6 UK competitors. **Fewest Moves:** FMC will **not** be held at this competition. To compete for the national champion title for FMC, you must compete at [Kewbz UK Championship FMC 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzUKChampionshipFMC2022) on 22nd October instead. The winner of the FMC competition will be awarded their prize during the awards at Kewbz UK Championship 2022. We will be taking videos and photographs of the competition and the environment for our social media pages and website. Media persons will also be in attendance. By attending the competition as a competitor or a guest, you are accepting that you may be filmed or photographed for these purposes. **Please Note:** As this is the UK National Championship, only competitors who represent the United Kingdom will be eligible for prizes. The competition remains open for all nationalities to compete. [![Kewbz](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/679033331912015892/1005532291797352509/RGB_FINAL_UKC_2022_LOGO_FOR_SCREENS.png)](https://kewbz.co.uk)

items.information: Välkomna till Svenska Mästerskapen 2022! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 7 sekunder eller 5 minuter. Det blir i år en 2,5-dagarstävling med alla WCA-grenar utom en, 3x3x3 FMC. Den Svenska Mästaren i den grenen kommer krönas på den separata tävlingen [Swedish FMC Championship 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SwedishFMCChampionship2022). Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. Tävlande av alla nationaliteter är välkomna, men bara deltagare som representerar Sverige kan vinna medaljer, priser och titeln Svensk Mästare. *Notera vänligen också att klockan ställs* ***tillbaka*** *en timme till vintertid i Sverige natten mot söndag den 30:e oktober, vilket betyder en timmes längre sömn!* ----- Welcome to the Swedish Championship 2022! Everyone is welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 7 seconds or 5 minutes. This year there will be a 2,5-day competition with all WCA events but one, 3x3x3 FMC. The Swedish Champion in this event will be crowned at the separate competition [Swedish FMC Championship 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SwedishFMCChampionship2022). We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. Competitors of all nationalities are welcome, but only participants representing Sweden can win medals, prizes and the title of Swedish Champion. *Please also note that the clock is set* ***back*** *one hour to winter time in Sweden on the night before Sunday October 30th, which means an hour more sleep!*

items.information: ![](https://i.imgur.com/Upxb5EP.png) Why SILENCE? We will be trying our best to provide you all with an ambience of as much as silence and serenity as possible! Irrespective of the events... Yes, Including 3x3 and other NxN events which don't generally demand silence. :) We aim to experiment and see how much more efficient we'd all be in an ambience more favorable for cubing. With minimal spectator pressure. We plan have separate rooms for waiting and competing, where the competing area would only have the competitors for the round, scramblers, and judges in it. We urge all the competitors to strictly adhere to the rules and regulations to contribute to the mission of providing a serene ambience for all the fellow cubers. If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time, please bring your ID card as well. items.information: NZ North Island Championship 2022 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations. In addition, NZ North Island Championship 2022 is the last regional championship of 2022 in the lead up to Nationals in December.
